decisions.rationale: “Retired FileManager bridge is explicitly non-product lineage” and “Worktree backend exclusions” share a subsystem or problem family, but they do not share all five merge axes. The left record owns F-001 has a precise compatibility-only disposition, explicit replacement range, negative constraints, validation surfaces, and a no-work-node boundary. The right record owns Validated local observation normalized as a distinct catalog concern: Backend non-goals sharply bound orchestrator, submodule, undo, cleanup, terminal, and transfer behavior. Shared vocabulary, analogous races, or umbrella/member proximity does not make them one feature.
decisions.authority_lifecycle_outcome_state_failur: Authority differs because the records govern separate contracts or resources. Their lifecycle and state boundaries do not coincide, their user or governance outcomes are independently observable, and their failure semantics address different invalid, stale, recovery, compatibility, or exclusion cases. They should remain distinct even though coordinated subsystem design is appropriate.
